summary: This clinical trial is testing HDM1002 tablets in adults who are overweight or obese. The study aims to see how well the treatment works and how safe it is. Participants are split into different groups to receive either the study drug or a placebo, which looks like the drug but has no medicine in it. The main goal is to measure the percentage change in body weight after 12 weeks.
